heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this chapter not more than $75,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2025 through 2029.

notes.text: Amendments2024—Pub. L. 118–159 substituted “2025 through 2029” for “2019 through 2023”. 2019—Pub. L. 116–9 substituted “2019 through 2023” for “2006 through 2011”.
